text: A talisman blessed by Khaine, the Blood-Handed God. Few have gained enough favor to wield a tool like this in his name. The dried blood pulsates with ancient power, whispering promises of violence to its bearer.
A talisman blessed by Asuryan to keep the knowledge of previous generations alive. When quiet, you can hear the whispers of ancient elven sages offering wisdom from beyond the veil.

A talisman of sorts blessed by Kurnous, giving the owner some of the best berry wine in the whole world. One sip connects the drinker to the wild, sharpening senses and quickening reflexes as if the forest itself guides each movement.

A weapon blessed by Kurnous to make its wielder into one of the foremost hunters the world knows. Those marked by its arrows feel a primal fear, as if hunted by nature itself rather than merely an archer.
This helmet reveals a face mask that is a mixture of terror, bloodlust and pure desire for violence. The visage transforms its wearer, awakening a primal rage that enemies can sense from afar.
A sword thirsting for blood as much as its master. With each strike, it hungers for more, growing stronger with each life it claims. The blade's edge never dulls when wetted with fresh blood.

A sword as perfect as its wielder strives to be. Forged in the eternal flame of Asuryan himself, this high elven style sword brings harmony to combat, allowing its master to fight with unmatched precision and endurance.

An armour by Kurnous design, light and barely noticeable. This dark green cloak carries the essence of the deep forest, concealing its wearer from enemy eyes while heightening awareness of one's surroundings.

This armor protects its wearer while he serves elven kind, prolonging his life to levels outside any expectation. The enchantments woven into each plate reject the corruption of undeath, allowing the wearer to walk both worlds.
